classrooms.desc: At Future Kids International School, Children learn in a peaceful, Welcoming campus designed to help them feel safe, confident, and at home. Surrounded by nature, our environment encourages curiosity, exploration, and joyful learning every day with an adventure trail, two age-appropriate playground, a rabbit's and an organic garden children enjoy meaningful outdoor experences that inspire discovery, creativity, and a lifelong love of learning

library.title: Thoughtfully Designed for the Future
library.desc: Every aspect of Future Kids has been carefully designed to support children's learning while caring for the world they will inherit. Our eco-conscious campus features creatively repurposed shipping containers, solar energy, and spacious green areas where children can learn, play, and connect with nature every day.We believe that a sustainable environment inspires responsible, curious, and confident young learners.

principal.title: Hong SamBath
principal.body: At Future Kids International School, we believe a great school is judged not only by exam results, but by the character of the students who walk through its gates each morning. Our teachers know every child by name, our classrooms stay small on purpose, and our doors are always open to families who want to be part of that journey. I invite you to visit our campus and see it for yourself.

history.title: School History
history.body: At Future Kids School, we believe every child deserves the best foundation for a successful future. We combine international early years education standards with the benefits of outdoor learning, creativity, and environmental awareness to nurture confident, curious, and caring young learners.Founded in 2010, Future Kids School was created with a commitment to providing high-quality education in a warm, inspiring, and green learning environment. Our purpose-built campus encourages children to explore, play, discover, and grow through meaningful experiences both inside and outside.We take pride in creating a safe and welcoming atmosphere where every child feels valued, comfortable, and supported. With a personal approach, small community environment, and dedicated educators, every child is known by name and every family becomes part of the Future Kids  community.

mission.title: UnderStanding the World
mission.body: Future Kids nurtures curious, confident learners by encouraging children to explore the world through hands-on experiences. Through sensory play, role-play as community helpers, small-world activities, nature exploration, and age-appropriate technology, children develop curiosity, confidence, and an understanding of people, places, and the environment around them.

vision.title: Communication & Language
vision.body: Communication and language are developed through meaningful interactions, stories, songs, and everyday experiences. Children build confidence in listening, understanding, and expressing their ideas, laying the foundation for reading and writing.

respect.title: Creative Development
respect.desc: At Future Kids’ International School, we believe creativity is essential to a child's growth and lifelong learning. Through inspiring, hands-on experiences, children are encouraged to express their ideas, explore their imagination, and build confidence in a supportive environment.

curiosity.title: Mathematics
curiosity.desc: At Future Kids, children develop a strong foundation in mathematics through engaging, hands-on learning. They build confidence in numbers, shapes, patterns, and problem-solving while applying mathematical concepts in meaningful, everyday experiences.

integrity.title: Literacy
integrity.desc: A Shared story between a child and a familiar loved adult has a huge impact on children's interest a motivation for reading later on 'Penny Tassoni President of PACEY' At Future Kids School, we foster a lifelong love of literacy through meaningful experiences that inspire curiosity, communication, and creativity. In a language-rich environment, children develop early reading and writing skills by listening to stories, exploring books, recognizing print, and expressing their ideas through mark-making and purposeful play.

items.cafeteria: A Safe and Green Place to Grow

items.text: Dedicated educators who inspire, guide, and support every child’s unique development through personalized care and meaningful learning experiences.
Our Montessori approach nurtures the whole child by fostering independence, creativity, confidence, and lifelong learning through a thoughtfully prepared environment

Conveniently located on Makara Road, just outside the heart of Siem Reap, our school is easily accessible within a short drive from all areas of the city, providing families with a convenient and comfortable daily journey.

A peaceful and nature-inspired campus where children feel safe, relaxed, and inspired to learn through enriching outdoor experiences, including adventure walks, playgrounds, sports areas, animal habitats, sand areas and organic gardening.

principalPhoto.title: Our Classrooms
principalPhoto.body: Our classrooms are designed to create a comfortable and effective learning environment for our children. Small class sizes to guarantee every child receives the attention they deserve and a soft color palette with natural surroundings to promote an at-ease feeling while avoiding unnecessary stimulants or distractions that could prohibit their learning progress.

hero.title: A clear pathway from first steps to graduation
hero.subtitle: Every child learns, grows, and discovers their path from their first school day to graduation.

curriculum.title: Designed with care
curriculum.body: In IPC Green tradition, this campus has a very welcoming and natural feel.  A relaxing atmosphere where children can feel comfortable and enjoy their learning environment. With features like a adventure walk, two playgrounds, tortoise habitat and organic farm the children get a chance to experience the outdoors throughout their learning experience. As a central part of our philosophy is to provide a better future for our children, even our school was designed with sustainable ideology in mind. Our structures made from recycled shipping containers, we create solar power, and leave plenty of natural green space outside for everyone to enjoy.
